evaluator.reason: No run-scoped M0 artifact gate is wired yet.
Historical M1 PASS exists, but no current run-scoped M1 artifact gate is wired yet.

M3 is defined by one terminal inventory predicate: ender_pearl>=12, the pearl half of the 12 Eyes of Ender that M4 needs. Pearls drop from endermen, so M3 requires a hostile-mob difficulty change (peaceful disables enderman spawns). Nether traversal is NOT part of M3; it is an M4 prerequisite because blaze_rod>=7 needs the Nether. No run-scoped executable gate is wired for M3 yet.

M4 is the Ender Dragon milestone: reaching and killing the dragon in minecraft:the_end. The listed prerequisites are the path (Nether -> blaze rods -> eyes of ender -> stronghold -> end portal). No run-scoped M4 artifact gate is wired yet.
